explanations: Correctness counts distinct held-out cases; repetitions measure variability.
Latency includes routing and grading. The interval resamples template families and cases.
No cash, subscription or production savings are inferred from an unexecuted baseline.
Assessment overhead is charged once; incomplete operations leave the total and break-even unknown.
Comparison structure: controlled_agent; admission uses predeclared utility and guardrails under fresh-worker. Conditions are never pooled.
Execution or environment failures are separate from incorrect output; no correctness conclusion is drawn from a missing result.
Controlled comparison requires the same resolved model in both arms; identity evidence is missing or differs.

timing_scope: Trial wall time includes routing and preflight; separately measured grading is excluded by BenchmarkRunner.
notice: All primary and auxiliary costs remain in the canonical ledger. Normalization alone is not efficacy or release qualification.
